fragments.title: schema_version_tagger
fragments.description: Stamps every record with a schema_version header attribute so downstream consumers can handle version-specific parsing. The pipeline-level runtime parameter SCHEMA_VERSION (default '1.0') is resolved via an EL expression into a per-record header attribute named 'schema_version'. Update SCHEMA_VERSION at job start whenever the upstream schema changes — no fragment redeploy needed. Compliance requirement from the banking brief: 'Schema version on every record — schema_version_tagger applied in ingestion pipeline'. stageOnRecordError=TO_ERROR routes any failed record to the error lane. Single-stage fragment: Expression Evaluator only. Works with any Kafka, SFTP, or MQTT origin across all industry use cases.
